families.definition: Compare values, show their distribution and composition, or examine relationships between measures.

coreCells.definition: Show the spread or concentration of observations or frequencies.
coreCells.gapReason: Distribution patterns are classified but have no public pixel proof. The generic heatmap census measures revenue intensity, not a distribution.

coreCells.definition: Compare quantitative values across categories.

coreCells.definition: Show how components contribute to a total.

coreCells.definition: Show relationships between quantitative measures.
coreCells.gapReason: No public registry identity assigned to this core cell has retained SVG proof.

families.definition: Show ordered change over time, multiple series, reference targets, and cumulative progress.

coreCells.definition: Show the trajectory of a measure over an ordered time axis.
coreCells.gapReason: No public registry identity assigned to this core cell has retained SVG proof.

coreCells.definition: Compare multiple named trajectories on a common time axis.
coreCells.gapReason: The multi-series pattern is classified but has no public pixel proof; the line type has trend as its primary core cell.

coreCells.definition: Compare a temporal trajectory against a reference target or band.
coreCells.gapReason: Target-band patterns are classified but have no public pixel proof.

coreCells.definition: Show an accumulated measure over time; supplied values must already encode the accumulation.

coreCells.definition: Show sequential positive and negative contributions to a financial balance.
coreCells.gapReason: No registered waterfall type or pattern provides sequential balance pixels; new financial chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195.

families.definition: Show distribution summaries, frequencies, or continuous fields using specialized scientific encodings.

coreCells.definition: Show quartiles, median, and whiskers of a quantitative distribution.
coreCells.gapReason: No registered box type or pattern provides quartile and whisker pixels; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195.

coreCells.definition: Show frequencies in explicitly defined quantitative bins.
coreCells.gapReason: No registered histogram type or pattern provides binned frequency pixels; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195.

coreCells.gapReason: No registered contour type or pattern provides continuous-field isolines; new scientific chart types are deferred beyond Sprint 195.
